texte.Un changement de processus est-il revu a: Is a process change reviewed before being applied?
texte.Un changement de périmètre est-il traité: Is a change of scope handled as such — and are its effects on the compliance strategy picked up?
texte.Un critère sans réponse n'est pas un « n: An unanswered criterion is not a “no”: as long as one remains, the DPIA cannot be said to be “not required”.
texte.Un cycle d'audit interne (art. #) et une: An internal audit cycle (art. #) and a management review (art. #) must have taken place BEFORE stage #. They leave dated traces: they cannot be manufactured the day before.
texte.Un déclencheur qui passe par le système: A trigger that runs through the system it is meant to stop goes down with it. It is the textbook case, and it happens.
texte.Un délai qui expire et vaut validation d: A deadline that expires and counts as approval destroys the guarantee of paragraph #(#).
texte.Un délai unique pour tout le système est: A single deadline for the whole system is almost always wrong: it is determined by the scenario, so it varies from one scenario to the next.
texte.Un déployeur qui ne connaît pas le risqu: A deployer who does not know the residual risk cannot accept it — and it is the deployer who accepts it.
texte.Un fournisseur de modèle change de versi: A model provider changes version with no notice: the reassessment is the only place where that shows.
texte.Un importateur ou un distributeur qui me: An importer or a distributor that places the product on the market under ITS own name or ITS own trademark, or that makes a substantial modification to it, IS a manufacturer within the meaning of the regulation.
texte.Un indice avancé ne se retrouve pas dans: An indication put forward that is not found in the declaration is not verifiable.
texte.Un inventaire des défaillances les plus: An inventory of the most frequent failures, not a compliance framework. “OWASP compliant” means nothing.
texte.Un inventaire des systèmes qui s'arrête: An inventory of systems that stops at the ones the IT department bought. The uses that arrived on a team credit card are not in it, and those are the ones that cause trouble.
texte.Un montant dont on ne peut pas dire d'où: A figure whose volume cannot be sourced carries no weight in a committee.
texte.Un objectif de volume horaire sur un pos: A throughput target on an oversight station is the exact antidote to oversight.
texte.Un organisme certifié en # a onze mesure: An organisation certified in # has eleven new controls ahead of it — not #.
texte.Un organisme notifié approuve et surveil: A notified body approves and monitors the quality system covering design, manufacture and inspection.
texte.Un organisme notifié examine le type, pu: A notified body examines the type, then the manufacturer guarantees that production conforms to that type.
texte.Un organisme qui conçoit ET exploite por: An organisation that designs AND operates carries both sets of obligations: the score retained is that of the weaker of the two.
texte.Un paragraphe « sans objet » sort du cal: A clause marked “not applicable” leaves the calculation; an unanswered clause counts as zero. The reverse would raise the rate the LESS you answer.
texte.Un plan d'action sans date ni nom n'est: An action plan with no date and no name is not a plan: it is a wish list, and the framework sets that minimum.
texte.Un poids se télécharge comme une image d: A weight file is downloaded like a container image, with none of the verification tooling that exists for software.
texte.Un pont n'est pas une équivalence : il r: A bridge is not an equivalence: it reuses a piece of evidence, it does not transfer an obligation.
texte.Un prestataire critique qui fait partie: A critical provider that is part of a group designates a legal person as coordination point, for representation and communication with the lead overseer.
texte.Un prestataire qui ne figure pas sur la: A provider not on the published list may request to be designated critical.
texte.Un périmètre qui nomme des entités jurid: A scope that names legal entities rather than products: it does not allow anyone to say whether THE system being assessed is inside it.
texte.Un périmètre écrit pour le certificat et: A scope written for the certificate and not for the product: it names the company, not the high-risk AI systems it places on the market. The notified body then opens a file that does not cover the system it has to assess.
texte.Un questionnaire encore écrit contre # n: A questionnaire still written against # no longer targets the standard in force.
texte.Un registre de risques tenu à jour et ja: A risk register kept up to date and never arbitrated. Everything is noted in it, nothing is refused, and the system ships anyway.
texte.Un retour qui ne prévient pas les proces: A rollback that does not warn the downstream processes leaves the system in an inconsistent state: one half has rolled back, the other has not.
texte.Un scénario de risque, son délai de réac: A risk scenario, its reaction time, the measure category retained and the measured intervention latency.
texte.Un scénario dont la latence dépasse le d: A scenario whose latency exceeds the deadline without the technical impossibility being recorded caps the score — no answer in the questionnaire lifts that lock.
texte.Un système classé ne rejoint le registre: A classified system joins the register only if “Add to the AI Register” is clicked: classification alone declares nothing.
texte.Un système d'IA change ; ses scénarios d: An AI system changes; its risk scenarios change with it. Oversight calibrated once ages without anything flagging it.
texte.Un système de surveillance après commerc: Is a post-market monitoring system established?
texte.Un système inscrit mais incomplet compte: A system entered but incomplete counts as one system: the ten essential questions decide, not the row.
texte.Un système monté pour l'audit et abandon: A system set up for the audit and dropped afterwards — visible at the first surveillance audit.
texte.Un système qui décide À PROPOS de person: A system that decides ABOUT people is not the same as a system that touches none.
texte.Un taux de # %. L'absence de mesure n'es: A rate of # %. The absence of measurement is not an absence of compliance — it is an absence of measurement, and the two are not the same thing.
texte.Un traitement déclaré sans sa base légal: A processing operation declared without its legal basis is not a documented processing operation.
texte.Un État membre peut exclure de son terri: A Member State may exclude from its territory the entities referred to in article #, paragraph #, points #) to #), of directive #/#/EU.
texte.Un écart entre la colonne « statut » de: A gap between the “status” column of the statement and the ground truth. That is exactly what the column is there to check.
texte.Un écart entre la déclaration d'applicab: A gap between the statement of applicability and reality — a control retained with nothing to attest its implementation.
texte.Une alerte dont le seuil ne vient pas du: An alert whose threshold does not come from the risk management file is an engineer's setting, not a measure.
texte.Une analyse de risque produite par la se: A risk analysis produced by the security team alone, with no arbitration of resources, does not meet this requirement.
texte.Une analyse qui ne cite aucune de ses ci: An analysis that cites none of its five inputs is an opinion, not an analysis — and that is what an inspection will look at.
texte.Une appréciation des risques qui n'a pas: A risk assessment that has not been redone: article # requires it at planned intervals AND after any significant change.
texte.Une catégorie dont les actions du profil: A category whose profile actions are not held cannot go beyond “started”; partly held, it does not go beyond “held”. The work done on the framework is not taken away — what is bounded is what can be said of it for a generative system.
texte.Une catégorie muette compte comme absent: A silent category counts as absent: the profile spreads across all of them.
texte.Une cellule de crise qui existe avant la: A crisis unit that exists before the crisis, with means of communication that survive the system going down.
texte.Une certification # ne dispense pas de l: A # certification is no exemption from addressing them.
texte.Une certification ISO/IEC # ne couvre pa: An ISO/IEC # certification does not cover the Top #: it meets part of it, brushes past another part, and leaves # entirely outside its reach.
texte.Une clause absente ne se rattrape pas ap: A missing clause cannot be caught up after signature: the contract has to be reopened, and the provider has no interest in that.
texte.Une commande d'arrêt trop facile à heurt: A stop control too easy to knock creates one more hazard; a control too hard to reach cancels the measure.
texte.Une conformité. Ce cadre n'est pas certi: Compliance. This framework cannot be certified: there is no auditor at the end of it, and nobody can issue an attestation against it.
texte.Une directive n'est pas d'application di: A directive is not directly applicable: what binds an entity is the transposing law of each Member State where it provides its services. The amounts and deadlines carried here are those of the directive — MINIMA imposed on the Member States. A national transposition may be stricter, never laxer.
texte.Une documentation technique est-elle éta: Is technical documentation established and kept up to date for EVERY AI system?
texte.Une déclaration d'applicabilité amputée: A statement of applicability with its third column cut off, or a risk register with no dated acceptance by the owners. Two documentary defects, and they stop everything.
texte.Une déclaration d'applicabilité incomplè: An incomplete statement of applicability — a control neither retained nor ruled out, or a decision with no justification. The defect is documentary, and it stops everything before stage #.
texte.Une déclaration d'applicabilité qui couv: A statement of applicability that covers the thirty-eight Annex A controls is not complete for that reason: it is complete if it covers the treatment options retained, which may call for more.
texte.Une entité financière qui est une microe: A financial entity that is a microenterprise may agree that the rights of access, inspection and audit be delegated to an independent third party appointed by the provider, the entity remaining entitled to request information and assurance on performance from it at any time.
texte.Une entreprise publique ou à capitaux pu: A public or publicly-owned undertaking is measured on its headcount and its accounts, like the others.
texte.Une exclusion motivée par les mesures de: An exclusion justified by the security measures in place is refused by the framework itself: “implementing security measures on those information systems does not justify a claim that they are exposed to none of the aforementioned risks”.
texte.Une gouvernance par les risques, tenue à: Risk-based governance, kept up to date
texte.Une immunité, ni une conformité. Une lis: Immunity, nor compliance. A list of risks is not a requirements framework, and addressing the ten does not exhaust an application's risks.
texte.Une liste faite une fois à la conception: A list drawn up once at design time. A system reclassified as high-risk during its life triggers nothing.
texte.Une liste recopiée dans un écran vieilli: A list copied into a screen ages without warning. This one is consulted at its source.
texte.Une matrice de compétences tenue pour le: A competence matrix kept for the auditors and never for recruitment. The day the team that knows changes, nobody notices.
texte.Une mesure ni retenue ni écartée suffit: One control neither retained nor ruled out is enough to make the statement inadmissible.
texte.Une mesure non renseignée n'est pas une: An unfilled control is not a compliant control: it stays in the denominator.
texte.Une mesure organisationnelle qui ne se f: An organisational measure that is not trained for is not held.
texte.Une mesure par scénario est le plancher: One measure per scenario is the floor; fitness to the deadline is the criterion. Where no single category suffices, they have to be combined.
texte.Une mesure taillée ne peut pas être plus: A tailored control cannot be stronger than the one it tailors: an axis declared above its #-# family is brought back down to it, and the overshoot is flagged rather than erased.
texte.Une mesure « prévue » n'est pas une mesu: A “planned” control is not an implemented control: what counts is the written procedure, the named person and the evidence that they apply it.
texte.Une modalité unique — le visuel — échoue: A single modality — the visual one — fails as soon as the designated person looks away, which is the normal case for a station that does something else too.
texte.Une norme européenne harmonisée, citée a: A harmonised European standard, cited in the Official Journal under the regulation.
texte.Une norme qui n'est ni harmonisée ni spé: A standard that is neither harmonised nor a common specification — an international, sectoral or national standard.
texte.Une ou plusieurs exigences essentielles: One or more essential requirements are addressed by “other standard” or “other technical solution” without the justification and objective evidence that §# calls for.
texte.Une ou plusieurs fonctions devancent GOV: One or more functions are ahead of GOVERN.
texte.Une partie de la preuve existe ; l'artic: Part of the evidence exists; the article additionally calls for something the standard does not cover.
texte.Une personne désignée qui ignore que son: A designated person unaware that their override feeds the model cannot gauge the reach of their action.
texte.Une personne désignée qui ne sait pas ce: A designated person who does not know what the system does after their action intervenes only reluctantly from then on.
texte.Une perte aurait un effet GRAVE ou CATAS: A loss would have a SEVERE or CATASTROPHIC effect, including serious harm to individuals.
texte.Une perte aurait un effet LIMITÉ sur les: A loss would have a LIMITED effect on operations, assets or individuals.
texte.Une perte aurait un effet SÉRIEUX — dégr: A loss would have a SERIOUS effect — significant degradation, financial or human harm short of life-threatening.
texte.Une perturbation du service pourrait avo: A disruption of the service could have a significant impact on public safety, public security or public health
texte.Une perturbation pourrait induire un ris: A disruption could induce significant systemic risk, in particular with a cross-border impact
texte.Une politique IA écrite par la conformit: An AI policy written by compliance, never read by those who build. It exists, it is dated, and it has no effect on a single architecture decision.
texte.Une politique qualité est-elle établie,: Is a quality policy established, and does it say anything about your AI systems in particular?
texte.Une politique qualité générique recopiée: A generic quality policy copied from ISO #: it passes the QMS audit and says nothing about the regulation.
texte.Une procédure documentée définit-elle ap: Does a documented procedure define approval, distribution, versioning, retention and withdrawal of documents?
texte.Une proposition de classification par sy: One classification proposal per unclassified system, with its indications, to be approved or set aside by a named person.
texte.Une responsabilité réglementaire attribu: A regulatory responsibility assigned to a function that has neither the budget nor the authority to stop a placing on the market. It will sign whatever is put in front of it.
texte.Une revue de direction annuelle sur un s: An annual management review on a system that changes every month. It arrives after the decisions it was meant to inform.
texte.Une revue du système de management est-e: Is a review of the management system conducted at planned intervals?
texte.Une revue sans indicateur de qualité ne: A review with no quality indicator cannot tell a doubtful identification from a poor image.
texte.Une revue sans les entrées ni la version: A review without the inputs and the system version cannot say whether the behaviour was within the expected bounds: it observes without being able to conclude.
texte.Une seule mesure non décidée renvoie l'o: A single undecided control sends the organisation back to the documentary stage.
texte.Une solution que vous avez construite vo: A solution you built yourself, or that your profession recommends.
texte.Une sortie rejetée doit être exclue de t: A rejected output must be excluded from any operational action, not merely flagged.
texte.Une spécification commune adoptée par un: A common specification adopted by a Commission implementing act.
texte.Une spécification incomplète transforme: An incomplete specification turns a passed-on obligation into an impossible one: the deployer cannot test what they have no interface for.
texte.Une surveillance après commercialisation: Post-market monitoring that waits for the complaint. The regulation calls for an ACTIVE approach, and that is the chapter neither ISO standard covers.
texte.Une surveillance détachée des scénarios: Monitoring detached from the scenarios is just a wall of screens: it is the deviation from the risk threshold that calls for an action.
texte.Une vérification qui rejoue le jeu d'ess: A verification that replays the training test set. It proves the model has learned, not that it holds its requirements.
texte.Une évaluation faite une fois, à la mise: An assessment done once, at go-live, on the version of the day. The provider has changed the model since, and the assessment bears on a system that no longer exists.
texte.Utiliser le système hors des conditions: Using the system outside the conditions of its intended purpose takes you out of the frame in which the provider demonstrated anything.
texte.Validation, risques résiduels acceptés,: Validation, residual risks accepted, action plan
texte.Vendre sous sa marque ou modifier substa: Selling under your own brand or substantially modifying a product makes you a manufacturer.
texte.Viendra à son tour. Rien n'empêche de l': Its turn will come. Nothing stops you opening it now.
